name: DeepSeek
short: DeepSeek V4 family on the official API; pay-as-you-go from $0.30/$1.20 per 1M (deepseek-flash, peak) up to $1.32/$3.96 peak (V4 Pro), with off-peak lanes at half price and cached input.

plans.name: DeepSeek API pay-as-you-go
plans.price: from $0.30/$1.20 per 1M (deepseek-flash = V4.1 Flash, peak) up to $1.32/$3.96 peak (DeepSeek V4 Pro)
plans.notes: Cache-hit input from $0.006 per 1M (Flash, peak) / $0.022 (V4 Pro, off-peak). Legacy deepseek-v4-flash names are retired and served by V4.1 Flash at Flash prices.

plans.name: Off-peak lanes
plans.price: Half of peak rates (V4 Pro off-peak $0.66/$1.98 per 1M)
plans.notes: Peak hours are Mon-Fri 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, excluding Chinese public holidays; all other hours are off-peak.
